title: Inkstone
body:
Description

Inkstone (or ink) is a common ore found on Finlay island and the second island, Ferwater. Inkstone ore can spawn in Beigeslate, Lightslate, Grimestone, Limestone, Chalkyslate and Prismarine nodes. The ore is glossy black spheres with two cone like drips coming off the bottom. The refined ore is black with a glossy foil surface and the forged ore is black with a sandy texture.

If refined or forged Inkstone comes into contact with a projectile from a Mysterious Mushroom, the Inkstone will transform into ? ? ?.

Trivia

  • Inkstone was formerly a joke page found on the wiki. It was seemingly made to trick players into believing Inkstone was real. The page went as far as to make custom renditions of the ore's refined and forged variations and even made up a location as to where you could obtain Inkstone. Once the joke page was discovered, it became a running joke in the community and eventually led to the developers implementing Inkstone and the formerly fake location Uncertainty Cave.
  • Inkstone has its own shape as an ore.
